description: Sends a message or reaction to a Chat conversation, which you can find with `participant_query` on Get Chat Conversations. Send it end-to-end encrypted by default: `encoded_message_create_event`, built with the Chat XDK. Plaintext `content` is only a fallback for a 1:1 chat that X Chat can't encrypt: use it only when the recipient's `receives_your_chat` user field (`user.fields=receives_your_chat`) is `unencrypted`. When `content` is refused, nothing is sent and the problem's `detail` says why; HTTP 400 https://api.x.com/2/problems/encryption-required means the chat can be encrypted or is a group, so send it encrypted instead. A recipient you can't message (closed inbox, system account, or a block) returns HTTP 403 https://api.x.com/2/problems/recipient-not-messageable.

event_id.description: ID of the message event the reaction is on.
ID of the message event the reaction is on.

encoded_message_create_event.description: Default. The end-to-end encrypted message: a base64 Thrift MessageCreateEvent from the Chat XDK.

encoded_message_event_signature.description: Base64-encoded Thrift MessageEventSignature for message verification.

id.description: A conversation's id from Get Chat Conversations, or the recipient's user ID for a 1:1 chat.

xdk_version.description: Version of the Chat XDK that produced the payload.
